newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asiana increases ex-Seoul cargo rates.
newsitem.headline: Asiana increases ex-Seoul cargo rates.

text.p: Asiana Airlines is increasing its ex-Seoul cargo rates by five per cent from Friday because of peak season demand and higher fuel prices, the carrier's deputy general cargo manager B.H. Moon told Reuters.
The November 1 rise was the third five per cent hike in as many months and would affect all Asiana routes from Korea, Moon said in a telephone interview from his Seoul office.
Asiana's ex-Hong Kong rates were also raised last month by between five and seven per cent again because of higher overhead costs, Moon said.

Many Asian carriers, already struggling with low yields on cargo traffic, have been further hit by fuel bill increases of more than 20 per cent and are all expected to impose fuel surcharges or rate increases as a result, industry sources said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
